Package paint.viewer.model

Class SquareControlParams

java.lang.Object
paint.viewer.model.SquareControlParams
public class SquareControlParams extends Object
The SquareControlParams class encapsulates parameters used to control the behavior and filtering of square grid configurations within the PAINT viewer.

It defines numerical thresholds for density ratio, variability, and R², and specifies the neighborhood mode as a string parameter. Instances of this class are immutable.

      public SquareControlParams(double minRequiredDensityRatio, double maxAllowableVariability, double minRequiredRSquared, String neighbourMode)
      Constructs a new immutable SquareControlParams instance with the specified control parameter values.
      Parameters:
      minRequiredDensityRatio - minimum required density ratio threshold
      maxAllowableVariability - maximum allowable variability threshold
      minRequiredRSquared - minimum R² value (0.0–1.0) representing statistical fit
      neighbourMode - the neighborhood interaction mode
